mapper.select: SELECT ir.INSPECT_NO , ir.PICK_RSLT_NO , ir.INSPECT_QTY , ir.INSPECT_RESULT , a.ITEM_CD , a.LOC_CD , i.ITEM_NM , pr.PICK_QTY FROM INSPECT_RSLT ir JOIN PICK_RSLT pr ON ir.PICK_RSLT_NO = pr.PICK_RSLT_NO JOIN SHIP_ALLOC a ON pr.ALLOC_NO = a.ALLOC_NO JOIN ITEM_MST i ON a.ITEM_CD = i.ITEM_CD WHERE pr.PICK_LIST_NO = #{pickListNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INSPECT_RSLT (INSPECT_NO, PICK_RSLT_NO, INSPECT_QTY, INSPECT_RESULT) VALUES (#{inspectNo}, #{pickRsltNo}, #{inspectQty}, #{inspectResult})
